name: PPC Completed Awaiting Closure
query:
SELECT
  jc.name AS `Job Card:Link/Job Card Computer Paper:160`,
  jc.customer AS `Customer:Data:200`,
  jc.specification_name AS `Specification:Data:200`,
  jc.production_completed_on AS `Completed On:Datetime:160`,
  jc.quantity_ordered AS `Cartons:Float:100`,
  jc.packed_cartons AS `Packed:Int:100`,
  jc.good_quantity AS `Good Sets:Float:120`,
  jc.waste_quantity AS `Waste:Float:90`,
  jc.rejected_quantity AS `Rejected:Float:90`,
  DATEDIFF(NOW(), jc.production_completed_on) AS `Days Awaiting:Int:120`
FROM `tabJob Card Computer Paper` jc
WHERE jc.docstatus < 2
  AND jc.job_status = 'Completed'
ORDER BY jc.production_completed_on ASC
